claude.sample_unit: prostate cancer questions (ChatGPT responses rated by 53 urologists/residents and 514 MTurk workers)

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses before vs after prompting for a 6th-grade level summary
links.effect: Flesch Grade Level 12.8(1.2) v. 7.4(1.7), p<0.0001; Flesch Reading Ease 36.5 v. 70.2; all six readability metrics improved. MTurk understanding of summaries 63.0-87.4%.
links.quote: Implementing a prompt that instructed GPT/LLM to produce a simplified answer to the prostate cancer question successfully improved the objective readability metrics.

links.outcome: Reading level of original ChatGPT outputs relative to recommended 6th-grade patient standard
links.effect: Original ChatGPT responses at best post-secondary grade level; mean FKG 12.8 versus 6th-grade recommended standard; simplified outputs averaged FKG 7.4.
links.quote: The FKG indicator is a surrogate for grade-level readability, and the original ChatGPT responses were at best written at a post-secondary grade level.

links.outcome: Lay user comprehension of simplified ChatGPT summaries via multiple-choice question
links.effect: MTurk workers (n=514) rated summaries clear (89.5-95.7%) but correctly understood content in 63.0-87.4%; scenario 1 only 63.0%.
links.quote: 449 (87.4%) MTurk workers correctly understood the content of the layperson summary of scenario 2 whereas only 324 (63.0%) correctly understood the content of the layperson summary of scenario 1.

unlisted_practices: Prompting an LLM to rewrite its own output at a 6th-grade reading level to improve patient readability

links.quote: Mean readability of layperson summaries was higher than original GPT outputs ([original ChatGPT v. simplified ChatGPT, mean(SD), p-value] FRE: 36.5(9.1) v. 70.2(11.2), <0.0001; GF: 15.8(1.7) v. 9.5(2.0), p < 0.0001; FKG: 12.8(1.2) v. 7.4(1.7), p < 0.0001; CL: 13.7(2.1) v. 8.6(2.4), 0.0002; SMOG: 11.8(1.2) v. 6.7(1.8), <0.0001; ARI: 13.1(1.4) v. 7.5(2.1), p < 0.0001).
449 (87.4%) MTurk workers correctly understood the content of the layperson summary of scenario 2 whereas only 324 (63.0%) correctly understood the content of the layperson summary of scenario 1.
The lowest approval rate was seen scenario 3 with 38 (71.7%) rating it as accurate, 42 (79.2%) as complete and 47 (88.7%) as clear.

links.outcome: Readability scores of original versus simplified layperson summaries
links.quote: Mean readability of layperson summaries was higher than original GPT outputs ([original ChatGPT v. simplified ChatGPT, mean(SD), p-value] FRE: 36.5(9.1) v. 70.2(11.2), <0.0001; GF: 15.8(1.7) v. 9.5(2.0), p < 0.0001; FKG: 12.8(1.2) v. 7.4(1.7), p < 0.0001; CL: 13.7(2.1) v. 8.6(2.4), 0.0002; SMOG: 11.8(1.2) v. 6.7(1.8), <0.0001; ARI: 13.1(1.4) v. 7.5(2.1), p < 0.0001).
